name: Missing AutoPay Discount
description: AutoPay discount not applied despite customer eligibility and no payment-method change detected.
rootCause: CGCM system sync failure during the Feb 12 maintenance window
dataSource: Billing system, account payment-method history, discount eligibility rules
action: Review the 87 impacted accounts and Apply Fix to All (returns $870 to customers, prevents an estimated 63 support calls)

name: Duplicate Device Installments
description: Device-loan installment charges appearing twice for the same IMEI in the current billing cycle.
rootCause: LoanSys database replication timing issue causing duplicate entries
action: Bulk-correct duplicates; highest per-pattern dollar impact

name: Incorrect State Tax Calculation
description: State tax calculated using an outdated rate table (12% instead of the updated 7% rate).
rootCause: Tax engine not updated with the Jan 2026 state tax rate changes
action: Apply the corrected tax rate in bulk; escalate the rule-version fix to Platform Admin

name: Plan Migration Rate Mismatch
description: Customers migrated to a new unlimited plan are still charged old rate-card pricing.
rootCause: Rate-card sync delay between ORBPM and the billing system during plan migration
dataSource: Plan catalog, rate-card table, migration records
action: Reprice to the correct rate card; confirm migration effective dates

name: International Roaming Overcharge
description: Mexico/Canada roaming charges applied despite the plan including free roaming in those countries.
rootCause: Roaming feature flag not properly mapped after the plan-update rollout
action: Reverse the overcharges in bulk; highest confidence of the set

name: Edge Cases — Individual Anomalies
description: Unique billing anomalies that do not fit an established pattern; each requires individual investigation.
rootCause: Multiple unrelated root causes requiring individual analysis per account
action: Investigate one at a time; escalate to SME where needed
